feedback: The linked list assignment was too difficult for a 1-week deadline.
I really appreciated the TA's office hours; they explained binary trees clearly.
Students are struggling with the memory management concepts in C++.
The lecture slides are a bit disorganized, making it hard to follow along.
The autograder takes way too long to run, sometimes over 20 minutes.
The new project on Hash Maps seems to be better received than the recursion one.
The mid-term exam was fair but the coding section was very long.
Great course content but I wish we used Java instead of C++.
Attendance in labs has been dropping since the second project was released.
The recursive thinking exercises in lab really helped me understand the concepts.
